Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE transparent pixel-art key-pose sheet for the SAME original game heroine as reference 1 (idle) and reference 2 (action). These images are design references, not images to reproduce a layout from. Do not redesign: warm ivory wavy shoulder-length bob with side part, same large amber eyes and round two-head chibi face, slate blue CLOTH tunic with small silver chest detail, burgundy waist cloth, white trousers, brown gloves and boots, thin short silver sword. Exactly same 48-logical-pixel body height and 28-pixel head width. Flat hard square pixels, consistent coarse logical pixel grid, no anti-aliased illustration. Crisp 16-bit hand-pixeled sprite aesthetic. No rosy/pink spots in hair or face.
Layout: 5 equally spaced columns in ONE horizontal row, transparent background, no text, no labels, no shadows, each full sprite inside its own cell with plenty of transparent margin. Same logical pixel size and same ground baseline. Render enlarged nearest neighbor to 1536x512 if possible.
First establish ONLY these FIVE KEY poses, left to right:
1 attack anticipation: front 3/4 facing right-down, lean subtly back, torso twisted away, rear foot pivoted and weighted; RIGHT near elbow bends and hand raises beside left edge of the head in screen space; sword tip behind-and-above to screen upper left, blade points northwest. Other hand balances forward. NO smear.
2 attack impact: front 3/4 facing right-down as reference2, torso lean forward into long stance, sword held ONLY in same right near hand, arm reaches across front of chest toward lower right, forearm and thin blade fully extended 25 degrees below horizontal, blade tip pushed forward, no smear or arc anywhere; only two tiny wind flecks at tip. Rear boot on tiptoe.
3 attack recovery: torso rising, stance closing, near right hand draws sword down towards idle, sword forward-down, not reversed. No smear.
4 walk contact right leg forward: front three-quarter right-down, short grounded walking stride, one heel forward and opposite toe behind; sword in right near hand held low forward-down with small arm swing, free hand opposite legs.
5 walk opposite contact: same facing and head, opposite leg forward, opposite arm swing. Walking, NOT running; keep one foot on ground.
Hair and waist cloth lag body motion. Full body must be individually PAINTED for each pose, not rigid stick puppet rotations. All five faces must have the exact reference shape and identical eyes/feature spacing. Sword always in near right hand.

Create ONE complete production pixel sprite sheet, transparent background. Reference1 locks original design C, reference2 is the original action design, reference3 is the approved key-pose blocking sheet: its five sprites represent attack0, attack4, attack5, walk0, walk4. Preserve those keys and fill the inbetweens. Same female ivory wavy bob, amber eyes, small silver chest plate over slate-blue CLOTH tunic, burgundy waist cloth, white trousers, brown gloves/boots. Two-head chibi, 48 logical pixels standing, head 28x27. Draw LARGE CRISP SQUARE pixels on uniform grid, NOT high resolution shaded illustration, no gradients/antialiasing. Same head and exact eye spacing in every standing pose, no face drift. Warm neutral ivory hair with four shades, no red or pink specks on face/hair. Same palette/outfit across entire sheet.
EXACT layout: EIGHT equal columns by FOUR equal rows, canvas 3072x2048 (or largest supported same 3:2 ratio). No lines, no labels, no numbers. Every cell has generous transparent margins. All standing figures have exactly same scale and ground line within cell; lying figures same physical scale. No image overlaps.
ROW1 left to right: IDLE0 neutral reference idle; IDLE1 shoulders/chest up one logical px; IDLE2 hold inhale but hair tips follow one frame late; IDLE3 exhale; HURT0 recoil torso back and knees buckle, closed eyes; HURT1 easing recoil; SIT0 seated on floor knees tucked gently, same head and outfit, sword resting low in near right hand; PONYTAIL alternate hairstyle full idle same face/forelock/outfit but replace wavy back bob with tied ivory ponytail.
ROW2: WALK0 contact right leg forward; WALK1 down passing weight -2 pixels; WALK2 legs passing under hips; WALK3 up +1 pixel back leg ready to contact; WALK4 opposite-leg contact; WALK5 down -2; WALK6 passing opposite; WALK7 up +1. This is GROUNDED WALKING NOT RUNNING. Feet alternate and near leg brighter, arms counter-swing with free arm larger and sword hand smaller. Hair/waist cloth lag by a frame.
ROW3: ATTACK0 anticipation from key reference, near right hand raised to left of head, sword tip up-left -135degrees; ATTACK1 torso unwinds FIRST, near hand still high, sword over head -80deg with a SINGLE thick 2-3 logical pixel pale blue to white smear arc overhead on right, no separate overlapping swords; ATTACK2 body leans forward, elbow drives forward, sword -25degrees moving over front chest, same arc progressing forward; ATTACK3 front foot steps 3-4px forward, extended near arm, blade +25degrees down-right with one continuous bold front-right arc ending at blade; ATTACK4 EXACT impact key extended pose near RIGHT arm across front of torso forward-down, blade 25deg below horizontal, blade 1px further forward than attack3, NO SMEAR/NO ARC, only 2 small detached wind bits, rear foot on tiptoe; ATTACK5 recovery key drawing right hand and blade back to low idle, no arc, tiny dissipating wind; cells7,8 EMPTY TRANSPARENT.
ROW4: DEAD0 knees collapse; DEAD1 slump low on one knee with closed eyes, losing balance to screen left; DEAD2 falling onto left side with legs extending to right, head tilted sideways; DEAD3 resting fully on ground lying on left side head left boots right, eyes closed, blade along ground still with near hand; remaining four cells EMPTY TRANSPARENT.
All look front three-quarter toward lower-right, no side-profile turn. The SAME NEAR RIGHT HAND holds sword throughout. Whole bodies are individually pixel-painted, believable torso twists, not rotated sprite limbs. Same length sword. No shadows, no ground, no scenery. Five key poses from reference3 should remain recognizable. Motion priority: hip/torso leads, elbow follows, blade lags; one-way clockwise blade travel behind-above → overhead → front → front-down, never backwards. The impact at row3 col5 must have NO large swoosh whatsoever.

Edit this complete pixel-art sprite sheet. Keep layout, scale, transparent background, heroine design, palette and all other poses. Repair ONLY walking row2 and attack row3. Eight columns walking, six columns attacking. Square pixels no glow.
Walking row2: genuine eight DIFFERENT grounded walking poses, not running, no duplicates. Right near hand MUST retain the thin silver sword in ALL EIGHT frames, including columns3 and7 which lost it. Eight poses contact/down/passing/up/opposite contact/down/passing/up. Column1 RIGHT near leg toward screen lower-right while far leg behind left, column5 SAME RIGHT near leg now behind left while far leg ahead right. Don't turn character. Column3 and7 single supporting leg under torso, other knee passing. Contralateral free-arm swing. Small sword swing in near right hand, tip angled down-right throughout. Shoulders bob down two pixels at columns2/6, up one pixel columns4/8. Same face.
Attack row3: keep anticipation col1, impact col5, recovery col6. Correct col3 (attack2): RIGHT elbow advancing in front of torso but sword still points 25 DEGREES ABOVE horizontal to upper right, one thick pale-blue/ivory smear from over the head to the raised blade tip. Correct col2 attack1: visible straight blade pointing 80degrees ABOVE horizontal, near hand raised at left edge of face and ONE coherent pale blue/ivory 2-3 logical pixel smear going clockwise over head to upper right. Correct col4 attack3: arm extends forward, sword tip 25degrees BELOW horizontal down-right, one 2-3-pixel smear ending at tip, same arc continues clockwise. Col5 impact: push front boot 3 logical pixels screen-right, rear heel raised on tiptoe, blade extension +1pixel vs col4, arm+blade at 25deg BELOW horizontal, absolutely NO arc, exactly 2 small wind flecks past the tip. Torso leads the elbow then blade lag. Same near right hand. Narrow all three smears to 2-3 logical px wide, no giant filled moons. No blurry aura around sprites. No pink flecks. Preserve every other cell. Each sprite fully within its cell without touching neighbor.

Create a correction sprite sheet of precisely EIGHT frames of a WALK cycle of the SAME chibi heroine in image1; image2 shows her sword-bearing right near hand. 4 columns by 2 rows, generous transparent spacing, no labels, NO background or ground shadow. Crisp large square pixel clusters, logical standing height48px, only nearest pixel hard edges. Same ivory wavy bob, same large amber eyes, slate blue cloth tunic, small silver chest accent, red sash, white trousers, brown boots and gloves. Always front 3/4 facing lower RIGHT, no profile.
The mistake to fix is repeating the same leg pose and missing swords. The same camera-near RIGHT hand on SCREEN LEFT at idle MUST hold a clearly visible long silver sword pointing DOWN RIGHT in every cell; sword crosses in front of thighs and extends past the knee. The other hand is empty. Do not remove sword in passing poses. Painted pixels, not an illustration.
Row1 frame0: near RIGHT LEG is stretched FORWARD toward screen RIGHT, its BROWN BOOT has heel on ground right of hips. Far left leg trails toward screen LEFT, toe touching ground. Near glove slightly back. Empty far hand forward.
Row1 frame1: right leg supporting weight to right, knees compress -2pixels, left rear foot lifts from ground and comes toward center.
Row1 frame2: right supporting leg under hips on ground; left knee passes forward in front of right knee, left boot off ground. Near sword hand under hip, silver blade visibly down-right.
Row1 frame3: right supporting leg pushes up +1pixel, left leg swings ahead toward screen RIGHT, near sword arm forward, empty far arm back.
Row2 frame4: EXACT OPPOSITE CONTACT: near RIGHT LEG extends BACK to screen LEFT, its boot shows upturned HEEL with TOE on ground LEFT of hips. Far LEFT LEG extends FORWARD to screen RIGHT, HEEL on ground. Brighter near leg is now the LEFTMOST boot. Same face/facing no mirror. Near sword glove forward; empty far hand back.
Row2 frame5: left leg supporting weight to right, right rear foot lifting and coming under center, knees compress -2pixels.
Row2 frame6: left supporting leg on ground under hips; right knee passes in front, right boot lifted off ground, sword remains completely visible in right near hand with blade down right.
Row2 frame7: left supporting leg pushes up +1pixel, right leg extends forward for next contact, near sword arm back, empty far arm forward.
This is a walk not run; one foot ALWAYS touches baseline, never both off ground. Contralateral arm swing. Foot trajectories describe an oval. Eight visibly distinct phases, two OPPOSITE leg contact poses. Whole figure same scale. Hair and sash follow a beat late, torso almost upright. Same face identical size/eyes. No bonus sprites.
